Hi Jared / team,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Recap: We covered product architecture (multi-tenant serving), data flows (customer prompt/data stays in customer tenancy for Dedicated/Private; hosted API uses transient memory with KV caching), and high-level security controls (encryption at rest/in transit, role-based access, audit logging).
- Immediate asks from FinCo: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and your vendor security questionnaire.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’m attaching a short Redwood security overview (Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf) to give your team a baseline (SOC 2 scope today, encryption, logging, KMS integrations).
2) If you can share your Vendor Security Questionnaire (or provide the link), I’ll route it to our security team and get answers back within 3–5 business days.
3) If FinCo has any specific data residency or scope requirements (e.g., cardholder data, PHI), call that out and we’ll flag it for product/security.

Two quick clarifications from our side that would help accelerate:
- Is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for your vendor assessments today, or do you accept SOC 2 Type I / security attestations?
- Are you evaluating ISO 27001 / FedRAMP for vendor baseline in the near term?

Happy to schedule a follow-up (30 min) next week to review the questionnaire results. Availability: Mon/Tue afternoon PST.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the overview doc, looks helpful. A few quick answers on our side: 

- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II for most vendors. We saw from your overview that Redwood has SOC 2 in progress for some services — can you confirm which model/deployment types are currently covered (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and expected completion date for Type II?
- GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR is a requirement for EU data; HIPAA only applies if we’ll process PHI. At this stage we don’t plan to send PHI to Redwood hosted API, but want to confirm encryption in transit and at rest, and whether you support a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for Dedicated/Private.
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching our standard questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinCo.xlsx). Please route to your security team and return when you can. There are about 75 questions — feel free to provide references to docs where applicable.

On roadmap/certifications: FYI, our security team is evaluating FedRAMP for some of our cloud vendors later this year; ISO 27001 would be a plus for long-term partnerships. Are those on Redwood’s roadmap?

If you want to set a working session to walk through the questionnaire, Priya and I can make time next Wed/Thu.

Thanks,
Jared Thompson
Director, Vendor Security — FinCo
jared.thompson@finco.com

Thanks for the forward, Marissa — reviewed the questionnaire and drafted initial guidance. High-level summary and recommended next steps below: 

High-level answers:
- SOC 2: Current SOC 2 coverage today applies to Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments (controls, logging, and access management). Hosted API is covered for infrastructure controls but some customer-isolation controls for hosted multi-tenant are in our SOC roadmap. Target for SOC 2 Type II coverage expansion (hosted) is Q3 2027. I’ve attached a short SOC2-summary.pdf we can share directly.
- BAA/HIPAA: We support BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API we can discuss scoped arrangements but prefer Dedicated/Private for PHI workflows.
- Encryption & KMS: Encryption in transit and at rest is standard; customer-managed keys (KMS) supported on Dedicated/Private.
- ISO 27001 / FedRAMP: ISO 27001 is on our 12–18 month roadmap; FedRAMP (if required) would be a longer initiative tied to SOC 2 scope expansion and significant engineering compliance work — classify as long-term (18+ months) unless prioritized by committed contracts.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Share SOC2-summary.pdf and our security overview with FinCo (ok to send).
2) I’ll draft responses to the questionnaire, flagging ~12 items that need product/engineering input (data retention, KV-cache persistence, third-party vendor lists).
3) Recommend a 45m working session with FinCo next Wed (3 Feb) 10:00–10:45 PST or Thu (4 Feb) 11:00–11:45 PST — Marissa, can you confirm which slot works for Jared/Priya?

I’ll put a draft of the questionnaire responses into the Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d) and share when ready.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
